name: WebWatch
shortDescription: Web data collection from explicitly permitted sources with change detection and provenance.
features: Allowlist + host-scope enforcement; unpermitted sources refused
Offline robots.txt evaluation; fixture transport by default
Conditional fetch (ETag) avoids re-parsing unchanged resources
Change detection with before/after diffs and dedupe by content hash
Run history with timestamps, status and schema-drift reporting
knownLimitations: Fixture transport is simulated demo data; HTTP adapter exists but is unverified against live sites here
Extractor handles h2/p patterns only (drift is reported, never hidden)
